title: Chapter 17 Opening The Treasure Chest
content:
Chapter 17 Opening The Treasure Chest

The two sides agreed on the details. In the end, Wang Shuo used 100L of water to exchange for 500 units of sand, and used 200 tiles to exchange for 100 iron ore.

Since he planned to cooperate for a long time, Wang Shuo did not let the other party suffer a loss. He exchanged completely according to his psychological price.

As the iron ore increases, the price should drop later. After all, Wang Shuo now knows that Zhao Shanhe also has iron ore.

As for tiles, as the house level gradually upgrades, the demand will only increase. However, Wang Shuo will definitely not be the only one who can make tiles by himself.

[Sand +500, Iron Ore +100, Water -100, Tiles -200]

When the materials were in hand, Wang Shuo was delighted, as if he saw the bronze key waving at him.

[10 bronze key molds = 313/1 wood, 500/10 sand]

Wang Shuo planned to make 10 first to test the water.

Soon, 10 key molds appeared in the backpack.

Take out a key mold and put it on the tool table.

There was only a square wooden box filled with sand and a small hole outside the box.

There was nothing special about the rest.

This key mold can be reused and is not considered a consumable item.

Wang Shuo silently said in his heart, "Make a bronze key."

[10 bronze keys = bronze ingot 50/1, coal 150/1, bronze key mold 10/10]

[Do you want to make it? ]

"Yes."

...

[Bronze key +10, bronze ingot -1, coal -1]

Wang Shuo was ecstatic. After working for most of the day, he finally got the key.

You must wash your hands before opening the treasure chest. Wang Shuo almost forgot, so he hurried to the kitchen to wash his hands.

He took out a bronze key, which was an ancient key style, shining with a metallic luster and slightly cold to the touch.

He quickly took out the bronze treasure chest. The treasure chest was not big, only 20cm×10cm×10cm in size, with a faint bronze luster and some mud on it.

At this time, Wang Shuo was confused again. Can it be opened?

What if the key and the lock don't match?

With a nervous mood, he inserted the key into the keyhole.

With a "click", the lock opened.

It turned out that Wang Shuo's worries were unnecessary. The system would not play such a joke.

But at the same time, the key and the lock could no longer be used again.

The bronze key became a disposable consumable.

Wang Shuo opened the treasure chest with great expectation, and saw a scroll, a blueprint, and a handful of gold coins filling the entire treasure chest.

[Liuyunji Pedestrian Merchant Summoning Scroll × 1, Fence Construction Blueprint × 1, Gold Coins × 10]

"Not bad, not bad." Wang Shuo was very satisfied.

[Liuyunji Pedestrian Merchant Summoning Scroll: After using it, you can summon a pedestrian merchant and trade with him. ]

(Friendly reminder: It is best to summon when you have enough funds.)

This looks like summoning a "mysterious merchant".

Wang Shuo secretly remembered that at a critical moment, this summoning scroll would definitely play a huge role.

[Fence construction blueprint: Use it to build a fence. ]

Such a concise introduction, Wang Shuo did not learn it immediately. He is now fully capable of building a wall with earth bricks, and he doesn't like fences.

At present, what surprised Wang Shuo the most was the 10 golden coins. You know, a fish only costs a few copper coins.

This can be regarded as a huge sum of money. Although he doesn't know how to spend it, it doesn't prevent Wang Shuo from liking it.

Wang Shuo resisted the urge to summon the wandering merchants now. Now is not the best time.

After working all morning, it was already 1pm. In the busyness, he didn't feel hungry. When he had some free time, his stomach started to growl.

Wang Shuo suddenly didn't want to cook. After all, he is now a "rich man", so he has to reward himself.

He opened the trading house to see if there were any players selling food.

After searching, he was surprised to find that many players had started to use currency to trade.

Modern people who are used to using money to trade, when there is a general equivalent, the speed of acceptance is really amazing.

What surprised Wang Shuo even more was that someone was really selling food.

"A basket of steamed buns, 10 copper coins, 11 portions remaining."

"A bowl of egg fried rice, 12 copper coins, 15 portions remaining."

"Big bone soup, 18 copper coins, 5 portions remaining."

Looking at the more than 30 portions of food posted in the trading house, all of them were sold by one person.

Wang Shuo guessed that this player had obtained the life profession of chef, or his birthplace was a farm, and he had no shortage of supplies. This was too comfortable.

Without thinking any more, he directly bought a portion of egg fried rice and a portion of big bone soup.

After the transaction was completed, two such icons appeared in the backpack.

Wang Shuo sat on the small table on the kang, silently saying "take out" in his heart, and the system prompted Wang Shuo that he lacked tableware for food.

Wang Shuo took out another ceramic plate and a ceramic bowl.

Suddenly, a bowl of steaming big bone soup and a portion of egg fried rice appeared on the table.

He took a bite and found it was even more delicious than what he had cooked yesterday.

He took another bite of the thick soup and it was still a little hot.

The taste was even better, and there were chopped green onions on top.

Everything in front of him made Wang Shuo ponder. What kind of game was this?

While making people feel breathless, they can also enjoy themselves greatly.

Wang Shuo certainly didn't get the answer, but he figured out a problem.

Every profession has its own specialty, and you must make good use of your own advantages.

While eating fried rice, he saw an important business opportunity.

Wang Shuo quickly opened the trading house again and found the player Chef Zhang with ID: 1210.

"He is really a chef!" Wang Shuo couldn't help but laugh when he saw this name.

"Brother Chef, are you there?"

After waiting for a while, the other party replied: "Yes, what can I do for you, brother?"

"Brother Chef, you are so capable. In this survival game, you actually started a catering business."

"Haha, you are welcome. I used to be a chef in a restaurant, but later for some reasons, I left the restaurant and became a butcher. After coming here, I killed some small animals and then thought about cooking for myself. I didn't expect that after a while, I actually realized the secondary profession of chef, haha!"

At this point, Chef Zhang was a little proud: "It's much more comfortable here than in the previous restaurant. At least I don't have to suffer."

Wang Shuo thought , so that's the case, but he was even more confused: "I haven't been a bricklayer before, is it because I moved bricks at the construction site for a few days?"

Retracting his thoughts, Wang Shuo smiled and said: "Brother Chef, I see that the food you sell doesn't have tableware. If the players who buy it don't have it, it will affect the dining experience. I happen to make plates and bowls. How about I supply you with tableware?"

Chef Zhang has considered this issue, but his business is not very good at the moment, and few people can afford ready-made meals, so he doesn't pay much attention to this issue. Since someone is willing to provide tableware, of course it's better.

The two reached an agreement at the moment. Wang Shuo provided Chef Zhang with 500 bowls and plates at the price of 10 copper coins.

Because bowls and plates can be recycled and reused by Chef Zhang, there are always some that cannot be recovered, and they will be replenished later.

Chef Zhang currently has only 200 copper coins, and can only trade in small quantities and multiple times.

Wang Shuo has no clay now, so he can only trade after he has materials.

After the discussion, Wang Shuo opened the [Chat Channel].

At this time, there was a lot of cursing inside.
